# cato_ip_address_range_container (Resource)

Manages an account-scoped IPv4 range container. INLINE owns all members, including an empty set. URL owns synchronization settings, not remotely fetched members. Name and mode changes require replacement. Changes are published by the API. Import by exact container ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_ip_address_range_container" "example" {
  name        = "example_ip_address_range_container"
  description = "Managed IPv4 range members"
  mode        = "INLINE"
  values      = [{from="192.0.2.1",to="192.0.2.10"},{from="198.51.100.1",to="198.51.100.1"}]

  # URL mode alternative: set mode = "URL" and omit values above.
  # URL mode manages synchronization settings; fetched members are not Terraform-owned.
  # file_type = "CSV" # CSV or STIX
  # sync_data = {
  #   url           = "https://example.com/members.csv"
  #   time_interval = 1
  #   time_unit     = "DAY"
  #   notifications = {
  #     mailing_list       = []
  #     subscription_group = [{ name = "existing-subscription-group" }] # or { id = "existing-id" }
  #     webhook            = []
  #   }
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Container description
- `mode` (String) INLINE or URL; changing it requires replacement.
- `name` (String) Container name; changing it requires replacement.

### Optional

- `file_type` (String) CSV or STIX, required only in URL mode.
- `sync_data` (Attributes) Required only in URL mode. Synchronization and notification settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_data))
- `values` (Attributes Set) Complete set of disjoint IPv4 ranges, required in INLINE mode. Overlapping ranges are rejected because the API merges them. Use [] for no members. Conflicts with file_type and sync_data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Container ID
- `size` (Number) Number of members reported by the API, which may change after URL synchronization.

<a id="nestedatt--sync_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_data`

Required:

- `notifications` (Attributes) Exactly one destination type must contain references. Use [] for the other types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_data--notifications))
- `time_interval` (Number) Positive synchronization interval
- `time_unit` (String) HOUR or DAY
- `url` (String) HTTPS source URL without user credentials or fragments.

<a id="nestedatt--sync_data--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_data.notifications`

Required:

- `mailing_list` (Attributes Set) Mailing lists (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--mailing_list))
- `subscription_group` (Attributes Set) Subscription groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--subscription_group))
- `webhook` (Attributes Set) Webhooks (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--webhook))

<a id="nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--mailing_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_data.notifications.mailing_list`

Optional:

- `id` (String) Mailing lists ID
- `name` (String) Mailing lists name


<a id="nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--subscription_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_data.notifications.subscription_group`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Subscription groups name


<a id="nestedatt--sync_data--notifications--webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_data.notifications.webhook`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Webhooks name




<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Required:

- `to` (String) Last IPv4 address, inclusive; at least from.
